"""Camera-guided Sharpie manipulation controller. Uses only Robot public API."""
import sys, os, json, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
r=Robot(); spec=r.spec(); cams=list(spec['cameras']); count=0
out='/app/output'
def capture(o=None,label=None):
 global obs,q,target,count
 if o is None:o=r.get_obs(cameras=cams,include_depth=True)
 obs=o; q=np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now'][:29]); target=np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now'][58:87]); count+=1
 d=f'{out}/{label or "latest"}';os.makedirs(d,exist_ok=True)
 for c,im in o.last.items():
  Image.fromarray(im).save(f'{d}/{c}.png');Image.fromarray(im).resize((960,720)).save(f'{d}/{c}_big.png')
 for c,dep in o.depth.items():np.save(f'{d}/{c}_depth.npy',dep)
 json.dump(o.meta,open(f'{d}/meta.json','w'),indent=2)
 print('STATE',count,'time',o.meta.get('time_left_s'),'task',o.meta['task'],'q',q[:7].round(4),flush=True)
 return o

def move(a,seconds=1.,label=None):
 a=np.asarray(a);o=r.submit('joint_position',a[None,:],dt=seconds,cameras=cams,include_depth=True,video='frames',note=label or 'vision control');
 np.save(f'{out}/action_{count:04d}.npy',a);return capture(o,label)

def cloud(cam):
 dep=np.asarray(obs.depth[cam],float);K=np.array(obs.meta['cameras'][cam]['intrinsic_cv']);T=np.array(obs.meta['cameras'][cam]['cam2world_gl']);v,u=np.indices(dep.shape);p=np.stack([(u-K[0,2])/K[0,0]*dep,-(v-K[1,2])/K[1,1]*dep,-dep],-1);return p@T[:3,:3].T+T[:3,3]
def pixel(cam,u,v):
 p=cloud(cam)[v,u]; print(cam,u,v,p);return p
capture(label='start')
PY
